mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_document (user_id, filename, byte_size, char_count, chunk_count, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{filename}, #{byteSize}, #{charCount}, #{chunkCount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, filename, byte_size, char_count, chunk_count, status, created_at FROM chat_document WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_document WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_document WHERE user_id = #{userId}
